name: Chin's Szechwan - Point Loma
notes: All 3 photos are the same printed double-sided menu: 1.jpg and 2.jpg are the front side (2.jpg photographed at an angle, showing slightly higher prices for some items and three extra dishes, Pao Hu Chicken/Pork/Shrimp, not visible in 1.jpg); 3.jpg is the back side (House Specialties, build-your-own Fried Rice/Lo Mein, sauces reference). Used 1.jpg's prices for items on both photos and merged in the extra Pao Hu items from 2.jpg. Entrees list separate Lunch/Dinner prices; used the Dinner (regular entree) price throughout. House Specialties items that repeat a dish already listed elsewhere with the same name were skipped as duplicates; the 'Other' section (rice sizes, condiment sauces) and 'Key Sauces & Ingredients' reference table were skipped as sides/modifiers, not dishes.
